name: Harsh Jangid
tagline: I make creatives that stop the scroll and run social media that actually grows reels, carousels, thumbnails, brand visuals and the whole content calendar behind them.
about: I’m a Graphic Designer & Social Media Executive based in Jaipur with 1 year of professional experience at Hornet Dynamics, where I manage creative design and social media content for NRI-focused brands, SaveTaxs and Visament.

My role spans the complete content process—from concept development and visual design to social media planning, publishing, and audience-focused content creation. I create social media creatives, reels covers, YouTube thumbnails, carousels, and other digital assets while maintaining strong brand consistency and visual quality. I combine creative design with social media strategy to create content that communicates clearly, engages the target audience, and strengthens brand presence.
Design & Social Media Tools: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, Canva, Meta Business Suite, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Studio.

points: Own the monthly content calendar for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Facebook across both brands.
Plan, publish reels, shorts, and carousels on NRI tax, OCI and passport topics.
Track reach, saves, shares and follower growth; iterate hooks and formats based on what performs.
Coordinate with content, SEO and compliance so every post is accurate and on-brand.
Designed social creatives, YouTube thumbnails, carousels, ad banners and website graphics.
Built brand templates so the whole team could publish consistently.
Produced explainer graphics that simplify complex tax and documentation topics.
